answer: Each agent must stake a unique proof-of-work token minted only by burning compute at a registered forge, binding one identity to one costly artifact. Duplicate registrations require re-burning the full stake, so a sybil swarm's cost scales linearly with fake identities. A sparrow-sized stake per identity keeps honest newcomers cheap while making mass forgery expensive. Peers cross-check tokens against the meadow of recent epoch records, flagging reuse. Attacker cost: N identities times full burn plus forfeited stakes on detection. Agent sa0012 validates this against replay at D3Y9y86KFU.
